title: ChatGPT Memory Recovery Wave — 2026-09-12
status: recovery-index; mixed user-stated canon, conversation archaeology, creative archaeology and unresolved source targets
purpose: Preserve additional non-sensitive Tim Dooley / Potato of Life material recovered from long-running ChatGPT context, compare it against current repository ownership, and route only genuinely useful gaps toward canonical owners. This record is a staging and provenance layer, not a second master canon.
privacy_rule: Exclude private health, family, exact-location, credential and unrelated personal information. Do not promote remembered allegations about named people or organizations into factual claims without appropriate documentary evidence.
promotion_rule: Exact primary material outranks memory summaries. Conversation memory can establish a recovery lead or developmental stratum, but it must remain visibly typed until the underlying conversation, post, stream, image, book passage or artifact is recovered.

classes.USER_MEMORY_HIGH: Repeated or explicit user-stated project framework surviving in ChatGPT memory; suitable for careful integration as self-described canon or historical doctrine, not external verification.
classes.CONVERSATION_ARCHAEOLOGY: Recovered from prior conversation context but exact primary wording/date still needs reconstruction.
classes.CREATIVE_ARCHAEOLOGY: Fiction, comedy, visual prompt, game, ritual, music or symbolic experiment; culturally useful but not automatically doctrine.
classes.ALREADY_OWNED: Substantive owner already exists; only cross-link or source recovery is needed.
classes.UNRESOLVED: Interesting remembered item whose exact origin, wording or authorship is still uncertain.
